most_common_words.description: Acronym for the Inter-Parliamentary Union, the core topic of the tweets.
Part of the main theme of the 144th IPU Assembly (Getting to Zero).
Part of the main theme of the 144th IPU Assembly (Mobilizing Parliaments to Act on Climate Change).
The host country for the 144th IPU Assembly.
Cleaned form of 'Bali', the location where the event was held (Nusa Dua, Bali).
Cleaned form of 'parliament', referring to the assembly of world parliaments.
Refers to Puan Maharani, the Speaker of the Indonesian House of Representatives (DPR RI) who hosted the event.
Refers to Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat (People's Representative Council/House of Representatives).
Refers to Republik Indonesia (Republic of Indonesia).
March, the month in which the assembly took place (March 20-24, 2022).
Cleaned word associated with 'kerjasama' (cooperation) between parliaments.
Refers to Russia, as the Russia-Ukraine conflict was a major topic of discussion.
Refers to Ukraine, as the Russia-Ukraine conflict was a major topic of discussion.
Refers to global challenges and solutions discussed during the assembly.
Indonesian for 'peace', representing parliamentary efforts for a peaceful solution in Ukraine.

model_evaluation_metrics.reason: Lexicon-based VADER classification was used on English translations instead of a trained supervised machine learning model. No ground-truth human labels were present in the dataset, so metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrices do not exist.

sentiment_trend_over_time.reason: There are no timestamp, date, or time columns in any of the extracted CSV files. The snscrape routine in the notebook only appended tweet content (i.e. tweets_list2.append([tweet.content])) without capturing date metadata.
sentiment_trend_over_time.contextual_trend: The tweets were scraped for the #IPU144 query lang:id since:2021-01-01 until:2022-10-01. The 144th IPU Assembly event itself occurred from March 20 to March 24, 2022, in Nusa Dua, Bali, Indonesia. Word analysis shows a massive concentration of tweets in March 2022 (referencing 'Maret' and '20-24 maret') during the active conference period.
